misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:102 - The diff-trimming loops can overlap, which crashes the verifier with StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.. The suffix loop at line 107 is limited only by the full string lengths, so `start + end` can be larger than the length of `value` or `sanitized`. Example: a translation with a missing `

`, such as `

a

b

`. The sanitizer returns `

a

b

`, which gives start=5 and end=8. Line 111 then calls `value.substring(5, 4)` and throws. The plugin crashes instead of reporting `Illegal HTML`, and this is exactly the kind of translation mistake the check is meant to catch. Fix: limit the suffix loop so it never reaches characters the prefix loop already counted.
